memory_update.text: HWKN is a priority underfollowed acid-logistics candidate because SEC filings explicitly identify sulfuric-acid storage/distribution inside Industrial Solutions, but segment purity and acid-specific economics require verification.
TGB is a small-cap SX/EW copper acid-consumer candidate; Florence ramp makes sulphuric-acid sourcing a potentially important hidden variable.
MOS is a direct sulphur-dependent phosphate fertilizer candidate; the chokepoint can be either a margin headwind or pass-through opportunity depending on finished phosphate pricing and curtailments.
SCCO should remain a reference anchor for integrated copper miners with captive/byproduct sulphuric acid rather than an underfollowed discovery candidate.
